title: Childcare Split, Rules On Every Sync
subtitle: Childcare becomes its own category with a combined Children view on the Financial Summary, and Import Rules now run with every sync. One upgrade to run, then a look at two tabs.
intro: After the pull requests merge, the code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade adds the new category rows and redraws the Financial Summary and Dashboard.

**What does not change:** no rows, balances or entered values. Tab names and column headers stay the same. The old "Child Care" subcategory stays on the Categories tab, unticked, so nothing that used it breaks.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before childcare split 2026-11-09`.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm. It takes about a minute.
steps.note: The report at the end should include a line starting "Categories: added Childcare / Nanny". If it says the upgrade is already current, wait a minute and run it again.

steps.text: Open the **Categories** tab and scroll to the bottom of the taxonomy table. Five new rows read **Childcare** with Nanny, Daycare / Preschool, Babysitting, Before & After School Care and Other Childcare. Higher up, the old Child Expenses / Child Care row has Active? unticked.
steps.done: Childcare appears as a choice in the Category dropdown on Transactions and Monthly Budget.

steps.text: Open the **Financial Summary** tab and scroll to the block **Children — childcare and other child costs**, just above Net worth. It shows Childcare, Other child expenses and All children combined with This Month, Average per Month and Share of Spending.
steps.done: The block shows $0 for now; it fills as childcare rows are categorized.

steps.text: Open the **Dashboard**. Under "This month" there are now two cards, Expected Take-Home and Spent So Far. The gross figure is gone from the Dashboard; the Financial Summary keeps the average gross and the month-by-month gross.
steps.done: Two cards side by side with a gap between them.

sections.heading: See rules run on their own

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Bank feed → Sync now**. The message now ends with a line like "Import Rules re-checked on the waiting rows: 3 updated, 3 imported into Transactions." Any waiting row that matches a rule marked auto-import moves to Transactions during the sync, nightly as well.
steps.note: The menu item that used to be called "Re-apply rules to waiting rows" is now "Apply rules to waiting rows now". You only need it when you do not want to wait for a sync.
